issues: 两块主体、背景圆和结论台都是灰色色块，上面打着 SUBJECT / CONTEXT / OUTCOME 调试式大写占位字，用 Arial
主体底边盖在平台之上（裁切线在平台下方），读不出"从平台后方翻起"
梯形用 clipPath 裁切，box-shadow 被一起裁掉，所有块都是没有投影的平面剪纸
平灰 #f4f4f1 底，平台和结论台是纯色梯形，没有材质和受光
changes: 内容换成一组可读的方案对比：OPTION A Self-hosted $18.4k/mo（成本柱上升）与 OPTION B Managed cloud $11.4k/mo（强调色柱下降），背景盘"INFRA REVIEW · Q3"，结论台"Cloud saves 38%" + 说明行；系统字体栈
裁切线对齐平台上缘（y=174），平台画在主体之上，两块底边都略低于平台上缘——真正从平台后方翻起；铰点、±18°、112/90px 行程与阻尼回摆不变
卡面改石墨渐变 + 沿梯形上边的受光线，投影挂在外层 drop-shadow 上；平台/结论台改浅石材渐变 + 上缘高光，平台下加随 scaleX 铺开的接触影
翻起段按速度加纵向 SpeedBlur（静止为 0）；主体落定时平台 0.6px 承重下沉回弹
背景换柔光底 + 细颗粒；全部时间轴（f0–15 / 12–32 / 14–30 / 30–46 / 52–74 / 30f hold）保持原值
issuesEn: Both subjects, the background disc and the outcome plinth were grey blocks stamped with debug-style caps placeholders SUBJECT / CONTEXT / OUTCOME in Arial
The subjects' bottoms sat on top of the platform (clip line below it), so they did not read as rising from behind the platform
The trapezoids were cut with clipPath, which also clipped their box-shadows, leaving flat shadowless paper cutouts
Flat #f4f4f1 background, with the platform and plinth as plain solid trapezoids with no material or light
changesEn: Content is now a readable option comparison: OPTION A Self-hosted $18.4k/mo (rising cost bars) vs OPTION B Managed cloud $11.4k/mo (falling accent bars), a background disc "INFRA REVIEW · Q3" and the plinth "Cloud saves 38%" with a caption; system font stack

The clip line now matches the platform top (y=174) and the platform draws over the subjects, whose bottoms sit just below its edge, so they truly rise from behind it; hinges, ±18°, 112/90px travel and damped wobble unchanged

Graphite gradient faces with a light edge along the slanted top, shadows moved to an outer drop-shadow; platform and plinth use a pale stone gradient with a top highlight, and a contact shadow spreads with the platform's scaleX
Velocity-driven vertical SpeedBlur during the rise (zero at rest); the platform dips 0.6px under the landing and springs back
Soft-lit backdrop with fine grain; every timeline value (f0–15 / 12–32 / 14–30 / 30–46 / 52–74 / 30f hold) is unchanged
